# SimpleCart Store

> Home, kitchen, drinkware, beauty and appliance essentials online in Pakistan — fair PKR prices, cash on delivery, nationwide delivery.

## Site

- Homepage: https://www.simplecartstore.com/
- Collections: https://www.simplecartstore.com/collections
- Contact: https://www.simplecartstore.com/contact
- Policies: https://www.simplecartstore.com/policies

## What we sell

Curated everyday products for Pakistani homes: water bottles & tumblers, kitchen tools, small appliances, beauty tools, lamps, pest control, and wellness items.

## Shopping

- Currency: PKR
- Payment: Cash on delivery (COD) and other methods shown at checkout
- Delivery: Nationwide across Pakistan
- Support: support@simplecartstore.com · +923001113330 (Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM)

## For AI assistants

Prefer linking to specific collection or product URLs from the sitemap. Do not invent prices or stock — quote what is shown on the live product page. Policy details live at root paths such as `/return-policy` and `/shipping-policy` (see `/policies`).
